Beautiful out of the box, easy to maintain, and built to convert users.

MDX Guides

Write flexible, structured guides using MDX with support for custom components and layouts.

Generate API References

API Reference pages regenerate from your spec on every deploy, so documentation stays current without manual effort.

Changelog

Share updates to your API and docs with a built-in changelog that keeps users informed.

Git sync

Sync docs with your Git repo to version, review, and ship changes through pull requests.

Search

Help developers find answers instantly with fast, accurate search across your docs.

MCP

Expose your docs through an MCP server so AI tools can query them in real time.

llms.txt

Automatically generate an llms.txt so AI tools can reliably read and use your docs.

Custom JS and CSS

Customize the docs with CSS and JavaScript to match your brand identity and extend functionality.

Bring your own React component

Build custom React components and embed them in your docs.

Component library

Leverage prebuilt components like cards, accordions, tabs, and code blocks.

API key injection

Automatically populate API keys so users can instantly make API calls and see realistic responses.

Access control (RBAC)

Show different docs to different customers. Restrict pages by role, team, or pricing tier so each audience sees only what they should.

Federated authentication

Put your docs behind a login so only paying customers can access them. Fern supports SSO, OAuth, and username + password.

Code editor

Edit your docs in a powerful code editor with syntax highlighting and live preview.

Writing agent

Generate and update docs from prompts or Slack threads using an AI-powered writing agent.

Web editor

Edit docs directly in the browser with a rich visual editor. No local setup required.

Preview links

Share a unique URL for every pull request so reviewers can see docs changes before they ship.

Versioning

Document and manage multiple versions of your product or API to support users across different releases.

Tabs

Organize content into tabs to separate audiences, products, or workflows cleanly.

Product switcher

Group multiple products under one docs site so users can switch between them without losing context.

Multiple repos

Aggregate content from multiple repos into a single unified docs site.
